1.consolidated_definition: Agitador, pica pleitos, buscabulla. Persona de carácter pendenciero que habitualmente causa problemas. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. El otro vecino es muy amable. Me dijo que no me preocupara por el troublemaker (El Bufete, blog, 21-08-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Troublemaker, pick fights, troublemaker. A person with a quarrelsome character who habitually causes problems. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. The other neighbor is very kind. He told me not to worry about the troublemaker (The Law Firm, blog, 21-08-06)
